# homebrew-karkhana

The Homebrew tap for the karkhana factory:

```sh
brew install sastaticket/karkhana/kh-setup && kh-setup
```

**Written by karkhana's tap workflow; do not edit.** Every formula and `pins.env` here is generated from `versions.env` in karkhana on each GA release (ADR 040). Changes go to karkhana's `packaging/`.
